prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on your goals, budget, timeline, audience and the services you need. I can help find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me shortlist strong St. Louis options and compare them for you:

Questions
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, patient acquisition, physician referrals, employer/employee outreach, product launches, research recruitment, etc.)
- What services do you need? (digital ads, SEO, website, content, video, branding, PR, experiential, analytics)
- What audience(s)? (consumers/patients, referring physicians, payers, B2B purchasers)
- Budget range and timeline?
- Do regulatory/HIPAA compliance or security certifications matter?
- Prefer local-only agencies or open to national agencies with a St. Louis presence?

How I can help
- If you give the answers above I’ll produce a vetted shortlist (3–5 agencies) in St. Louis with strengths, relevant case examples, estimated fees/fit, and one recommended choice.
- Or I can give a comparison checklist and sample RFP/interview questions so you can vet agencies yourself.

How to evaluate agencies (quick rubric)
- Healthcare experience & relevant case studies (same audience/condition/service)
- Regulatory & privacy expertise (HIPAA, data security)
- Measurable results (CPL, CPA, conversion lifts, ROI) and analytics approach
- Full-service vs. specialty fit (do they cover everything you need?)
- Creative quality and healthcare-savvy messaging
- Team structure & senior involvement
- References from similar clients and measurable KPIs
- Cost, contract flexibility, reporting cadence & turnaround times
- Cultural fit and communication style

Sample questions to ask agencies
- Tell me about a recent healthcare campaign you ran for a client like us. What were the KPIs and results?
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient data security?
- How will you measure ROI and what reporting will we get?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and who does the strategy?
- What’s your pricing model and typical contract length?
- Can you provide 2–3 references in our sector?

If you want, answer the quick questions above and I’ll research and recommend 3–5 St. Louis healthcare marketing agencies tailored to your needs. Which approach do you prefer?
